stories.title: Chourio Walk-Off Single Gives Brewers 2-0 NLDS Lead Over Padres

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
WALK. OFF. JACKSON CHOURIO.

2 outs. 2 strikes. Bases loaded. Mason Miller on the mound throwing 104 mph.

Chourio lined it 101 mph the other way. Yelich and Frelick scored.

Brewers 4, Padres 3. Milwaukee leads the NLDS 2-0.

#Brewers #Padres #NLDS

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
The numbers on that Chourio walk-off:

⚡ Facing Mason Miller — 104+ mph closer
⚡ Count: 2 outs, 2 strikes, bases loaded
⚡ Exit velocity: 101.3 mph
⚡ Result: bases-clearing single

Milwaukee's up 2-0 in the NLDS. They're in position to finish this at home.

#Brewers #NLDS

stories.title: Jacob Misiorowski Sets Postseason Pitch Speed Record at 104.8 MPH

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
104.8 mph.

Jacob Misiorowski just set the fastest postseason pitch record since tracking began in 2008.

Previous record: Mason Miller, 104.5 mph — this postseason.
Before that: Aroldis Chapman, 104.2 mph, 2010.

Velocity is a different sport now.

#Brewers #MLB
